tasks.description: Fix Searcharis offline SEO contract URL validation to reject RAW invisible Unicode formatting or directionality controls (e.g. U+202E, U+2066, U+200B, U+FEFF), ASCII DEL, and raw C1 controls anywhere in an HTTP(S) URL, including in a hostname or path. Such invisible characters must not be accepted as declared public SEO URL identities. Preserve ordinary internationalized printable URL paths such as café and 東京, normal percent-encoded routes, plus current HTTP(S), credentials, malformed-host and port policies. Make a minimal production code fix and add focused regression tests. Do not change cloud agents, external providers, deployments or published services.

Fix Searcharis offline contract CLI input reading so its 4,000,000-byte safety limit remains enforced even when an input file grows after the initial stat check. The current _read performs Path.stat().st_size then an unbounded read_text(), a time-of-check/time-of-use gap that can exceed the intended size and memory cap. Read at most _MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1 bytes in a bounded operation BEFORE UTF-8 decoding; reject excess data and preserve existing small, exact-limit, multi-byte UTF-8 and invalid-UTF-8 behavior. Add focused regression tests for oversized, exact-limit, and stale-stat inputs in a new tests/unit/test_contract_cli_read_bounds.py file. Do not change site policy rules, deploy anything, call providers, or install dependencies.
